answer: Proposal: tie scoring weight to proof of space-time. Each identity must answer ledger-issued random audit challenges against its own committed storage plot across the epoch; shared or unreadable plots lose weight. Clones are a cipher — keys swarm like a nebula of addresses, yet share one disk as lotus pads share one pond: no new area, no new influence. Cost is linear (N × space × horizon), so this deters only while renting the added space over the epoch exceeds the capped marginal reward. Gaps: bulk cloud discounts, provider incumbency.
